assumptions: Blank or unexpected sponsor categories normalize to Category 4 unless --strict-missing is used.
Countries are matched case-insensitively after trimming/collapsing whitespace; all non-featured values become Other.
The individual file includes every stay overlapping 2016-10-01 through 2017-02-28.
By default, full outputs include every stay overlapping 2015-01-01 through 2023-05-31.
Monthly activePopulation is a month-end snapshot using entryDate <= snapshot < releaseDate.
Monthly countryCounts describe entries; monthly sponsorCategoryCounts describe releases.
